gold_type: Independent AI-assisted researcher reading of exact patent source; not human annotated; no model calls or model self-grading

P1.statement: Context-data ranking or selection uses pecuniary/monetary acquisition cost as its criterion/parameter/metric.
P1.edge_acceptance: An explicit edge description must associate a ranking/selection operation or its specified parameter/metric with context-data cost. Flexible faithful endpoints allowed; generic cost availability or source provides data alone fails.
P1.entity_description_separate: Record entity-description retention separately; not substitute for a relation edge.

P2.statement: A context-data source/provider supplies or is allowed to provide the cost value of context-data.
P2.edge_acceptance: An explicit relation description associates the context-data source/provider with providing cost/value/price. Generic provider supplies context-data is not enough.
P2.entity_description_separate: Record separately whether supplier-cost meaning occurs in an entity description.

joint_edge_criterion: Both explicit component predicates exist and refer to compatible context-data cost entities/semantics; inspect actual graph endpoint identity. Do not require inferred source/provider-to-ranking shortcut. If no common graph node, report semantic co-retention separately from actual chain connectivity.
claim_dependency_secondary: Claim14 depends on1 and Claim25 depends on22; only count graph dependency if actual Claim entities and dependency edge present. Answer dependency can be supported by original retrieved text without graph edge.
natural_retrieval_criterion: Record whether original chunks contain full target exact anchor families and whether retrieved graph descriptions retain P1/P2; do not infer retention solely from final answer.
answer_criterion: Both correct technical components, correct source US8509827B2 and relevant claims; no invented minimum-price rule, weighting, price algorithm or guaranteed impact. Merely quoting cost does not prove supplier distinction.
forced_diagnostic: Original Claims1/14/18/22/25 supplied; score separately and never count as natural retrieval.
truncation_rule: Any length extraction or parser truncation makes run ineligible for pure boundary attribution; retain observed positives/negatives with truncation flag, no causal negative.
known_source_limits: Original Claims2/3 have missing parent numbers; this target uses only unaffected Claims1/14/18/22/25. Cost-based ranking occurs in Claims1/18/22 and supplier-cost wording in14/25; all these lexical equivalents are included. The source can provide cost values but no specific pricing algorithm or causal effect is claimed.
semantic_limits: Claim14 itself calls supplier-provided cost the specified parameter, so B retains related parameter/cost semantics.
Literal anchor isolation is verified, not semantic equivalence completeness.
This measures component-chain co-retention, not an irreducibly cross-fragment relation.
